name: survarium::weapon::request_aim_slot_switch
evidence: Descriptive name: (weapon) from the input apply 0x200301940 on input bits 42, 43 or 45 (mask 0x2c0000000000 at 0x200301a0f). Nothing with one aim slot or a switch pending (+0x4484 != +0x4483) or when the core cannot act (vtable +0xa0). Bit 45 (action scope_next, default key T: the action table 0x200aa1700, row 0x2a): the next aim slot, wrapping, whose owner module (weapon_slot+0x80) differs from the current one's; bit 42 the next and bit 43 the previous slot of the same owner, no wrap (a magnified optic's aim / aim_2: its two zooms). Sets +0x4484 = that index and the end time +0x4488 = now (+0x4468) + scope_switch_delay (0x200a9000c, 500 ms) or zoom_switch_delay (0x200a90008, 70 ms), and for bit 45 tail-calls vtable +0x1a8 (0x2006d87d0) with the delay.
